Untrusted content: build_get_skills, build_get_service_contract, build_stage_bundle, build_teardown, build_list_capabilities, build_verify, sdk_download · Private data: build_get_examples, build_whoami, build_create_project, build_set_project_mode, build_replace_project, build_publish, build_stage_bundle, build_get_bundle, build_go_live, build_teardown, build_configure_services, build_import_services, build_audit, build_verify, build_connect_data_source, apikey_get_scope · Public sink: build_get_skills, build_publish, build_stage_bundle, build_list_capabilities, build_recommend_integrations, build_configure_services, build_import_services, build_doctor, build_verify, build_smoke_test, schema_save · Destructive: build_get_bundle, build_deploy, build_deploy_status, build_logs, build_go_live, build_teardown, build_import_services, build_doctor, build_audit, build_smoke_test, build_connect_data_source, build_discover_source, build_bind_data_source, build_run_data_source, build_list_bound_schemas, crud_delete, schema_delete, connector_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: build_get_skills, build_get_service_contract, build_stage_bundle, build_teardown, build_list_capabilities, build_verify, sdk_download · Private data: build_get_examples, build_whoami, build_create_project, build_set_project_mode, build_replace_project, build_publish, build_stage_bundle, build_get_bundle, build_go_live, build_teardown, build_configure_services, build_import_services, build_audit, build_verify, build_connect_data_source, apikey_get_scope · Public sink: build_get_skills, build_publish, build_stage_bundle, build_list_capabilities, build_recommend_integrations, build_configure_services, build_import_services, build_doctor, build_verify, build_smoke_test, schema_save · Destructive: build_get_bundle, build_deploy, build_deploy_status, build_logs, build_go_live, build_teardown, build_import_services, build_doctor, build_audit, build_smoke_test, build_connect_data_source, build_discover_source, build_bind_data_source, build_run_data_source, build_list_bound_schemas, crud_delete, schema_delete, connector_run
